{{Quote|I'm sorry to intrude, Viceroy, but apparently there is some problem with your shuttle. Eriadu Spaceport Control needs to speak with you at once.|Unidentified Human page to Nute Gunray|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Eriadu Spaceport Control''' was a security organization located in [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]<ref name="CoD" /> circa [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> Spaceport Control was involved in the safety of the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] and aftermath, specifically around the area of the [[Eriadu Spaceport|spaceport]]. They helped manage those going in and out of the area.<ref name="CoD" />
